food_safety.label: Food Safety / FSSAI Compliance
food_safety.description: Applies to any product that contacts or contains food — packaging, cookware, containers, or ingredients.
food_safety.applies_when: The material or category involves direct food contact (kitchenware, food storage, some cosmetics).
food_safety.required_action: Confirm FSSAI registration/license where applicable, and verify food-grade material certification from the supplier.
food_safety.penalty_risk_notes: Product seizure and enforcement risk for non-compliant food-contact goods; reputational damage arrives well before any legal action does.

electronics_certification.label: BIS / Electronics Certification
electronics_certification.description: Applies to electronic and electrical accessories sold in India.
electronics_certification.applies_when: The category is Electronics Accessories, or the material is electronic.
electronics_certification.required_action: Verify BIS registration (CRS scheme) for the applicable electronics category before sourcing at volume.
electronics_certification.penalty_risk_notes: Non-compliant electronics can be delisted by marketplaces and are subject to regulatory seizure.
electronics_certification.verification_source_hint: BIS CRS government registry — Government-tier evidence (PRS §5).

textile_labeling.label: Textile Labeling Requirements
textile_labeling.description: Applies to apparel and fabric-based products.
textile_labeling.applies_when: The category is Apparel & Fashion, or the material is fabric.
textile_labeling.required_action: Confirm fiber-content and care-label accuracy matches the garment's actual composition.
textile_labeling.penalty_risk_notes: Mislabeling drives return and complaint volume even where legal enforcement is lax — a real margin risk, not only a compliance one.
textile_labeling.verification_source_hint: Supplier-provided fabric composition certificate — Manufacturer-tier evidence (PRS §5), independently spot-checked.

cosmetics_regulation.label: Cosmetics / CDSCO Compliance
cosmetics_regulation.description: Applies to formulated beauty and personal care products.
cosmetics_regulation.applies_when: The category is Beauty & Personal Care and the product is a formulated item, not just an applicator or tool.
cosmetics_regulation.required_action: Confirm CDSCO cosmetic registration and ingredient-safety documentation from the manufacturer.
cosmetics_regulation.penalty_risk_notes: Formulated products carry real consumer-safety liability — one of the highest-stakes compliance flags in this catalog.

toy_safety.label: Toy Safety Certification
toy_safety.description: Applies to toys and children's play products.
toy_safety.applies_when: The category is Baby & Kids and the product is intended for direct child use or play.
toy_safety.required_action: Confirm BIS toy safety certification, and check small-parts/choking-hazard labeling requirements for the relevant age group.
toy_safety.penalty_risk_notes: Child-safety non-compliance carries the highest reputational and legal risk of any flag in this catalog.
toy_safety.verification_source_hint: BIS toy safety registry — Government-tier evidence (PRS §5).

import_restricted.label: Import Restriction Risk
import_restricted.description: Applies to internationally sourced products in categories with known import-control history.
import_restricted.applies_when: The country of origin is outside India and the category (notably electronics) has a history of import licensing or restriction.
import_restricted.required_action: Check the current DGFT import policy for the specific HSN code before committing to an international supplier.
import_restricted.penalty_risk_notes: Customs seizure and shipment-delay risk if the HSN/category is currently restricted or requires a license not yet obtained.
import_restricted.verification_source_hint: DGFT government policy notification — Government-tier evidence (PRS §5).

weights_measures_declaration.label: Legal Metrology (Weights & Measures) Declaration
weights_measures_declaration.description: Applies to any pre-packaged product sold by count, weight, or volume.
weights_measures_declaration.applies_when: The product is pre-packaged and sold with a declared quantity — true of most physical goods.
weights_measures_declaration.required_action: Confirm the package declares MRP, net quantity, date of manufacture, and manufacturer/packer/importer details as required by the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules.
weights_measures_declaration.penalty_risk_notes: A common, easy-to-overlook compliance gap — marketplaces are increasingly enforcing this at listing time.

gst_standard.label: Standard GST Classification
gst_standard.description: A general reminder that the GST slab is category/HSN-dependent, not a fixed universal rate.
gst_standard.applies_when: Always — every product needs a confirmed HSN-linked GST rate before pricing is finalized.
gst_standard.required_action: Confirm the exact HSN code and its current GST slab — do not assume the category's 'typical' rate applies to this specific product.
gst_standard.penalty_risk_notes: Incorrect GST classification affects both pricing accuracy and compliance exposure.
gst_standard.verification_source_hint: GST portal HSN lookup — Government-tier evidence (PRS §5).

hsn_required.label: HSN Code Required for Listing
hsn_required.description: Most marketplaces require a valid HSN code at listing time for tax-invoice generation.
hsn_required.applies_when: Always, before listing on any GST-registered marketplace.
hsn_required.required_action: Obtain the correct HSN code — not a guessed or approximate one — before finalizing the listing.
hsn_required.penalty_risk_notes: An incorrect HSN code can misclassify GST liability and cause invoice-reconciliation issues later.
hsn_required.verification_source_hint: GST portal HSN lookup — Government-tier evidence (PRS §5).
